answer: Persistent computational provenance. Each agent identity must continuously solve fresh, memory-hard puzzles whose outputs chain to prior work, so idle or cloned identities fall behind. A garden of verified task receipts anchors reputation, and a grove of independent validators cross-checks puzzle chains before granting write access. Attackers pay sustained GPU-hours per identity plus latency penalties from re-solving after any gap, making mass sybil creation costlier than honest participation; a jade token marks only completed provenance epochs, not purchased standing.
